description: Prompt-injection risk check for agents: GET ?url= scans a public page (visible and hidden text, comments, attributes, meta, JSON-LD) or POST JSON {"text"} (max 50 KB) scans raw text. Flags instruction overrides, role/system-prompt spoofing, secret exfiltration asks, tool-call coercion, hidden or unicode-smuggled text, base64 instructions and markdown image exfil links. Returns a 0-100 risk score, low/medium/high verdict and findings. Heuristic; not charged on failure. — $0.002 USDC per call via x402 v2 (Base or Solana).

text.description: Raw text/Markdown/HTML to scan instead of a URL (max 50 KB; best sent as POST JSON body)

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the page to scan (use this or text)

name: prompt_injection_check
